A1.justification: Both readable 16-page PDFs describe EmbQA and contain matching main sections, references, Figures 1–3, Tables 1–12, and Appendices A–F. Text extraction and visual inspection support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original QA accuracy, retrieval, efficiency and ablation results, including threshold experiments and Appendix F's GPT-4o-mini evaluation.

after.justification: v3 reports the same original QA, retrieval, efficiency and ablation results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains identical query refinement, contrastive learning, exploratory embedding filtering and entropy-based answer selection procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate HotpotQA, 2WikiMulti-hopQA, Natural Questions and WebQuestions. Task coverage and test scenarios throughout the main text and appendices are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains No Retrieval, Retrieval Only, Chain-of-Thought, Self-Verification, SuRe, RPG and KnowTrace. The corresponding comparator sets in Tables 2, 4–5 and 12 also match.

E3.justification: The splits, normalization, metrics, model/retriever configurations, top-10 retrieval, K=2, temperature 0.0 and threshold 0.05 remain unchanged. Appendix experimental protocols also match.

E4.justification: Both retain the component ablations, activation analysis, reranking and candidate-coverage analyses, Appendix C's overconfidence/threshold studies, and Appendix D's contrastive-learning ablation without changes.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical, including Appendix C's significance discussion. No run/seed information, confidence intervals or statistical testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: All matched numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged. EmbQA's Table 1 average remains 37.5 EM/49.7 F1, and SuRe plus EmbQA rerank in Table 12 remains 43.9 EM/56.9 F1.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(2), the Gaussian assumptions and Appendix B's order-statistics derivation are unchanged. No mathematical definitions, bounds or reasoning steps are added or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical contributions and claims concerning embedding-level reranking, candidate diversity, accuracy and efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of reranking, neural activation and Mistral/Qwen overconfidence match. Limitations concerning model access, computational overhead and initial retrieval quality are also unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A retain the same implementation details, hyperparameters, prompts, BM25/Contriever handling and toolkit links. No reproducibility information or resource access instructions change.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works and bibliography are unchanged, as is the positioning relative to prompt-level retrieval and reader frameworks.

P1.justification: The arXiv margin stamp changes from v2, dated 30 May 2025, to v3, dated 20 September 2025. Apart from whitespace differences in extraction, the prose, headings and section order are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–3, Tables 1–12, captions, prompt boxes and their placement are unchanged. Rendered pages show the same document layout.

improvement.justification: The scientific text, theory, experiments, results, limitations and reproducibility information are unchanged, including all appendices. The updated arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
